finding.claim: In a repository whose .okf/index.md already exists but has no manifesto.md, init creates .okf/manifesto.md and leaves the kept index and log.md alone. The new manifesto is then not linked from the root index, and no log line names it. The run still exits 0 and prints Next as though the bundle were whole. At minimum the human output should say the kept index does not link the new manifesto (or that log.md was kept), and a test should cover the partial-bundle case.

fixes.change: --path now requires an existing folder (exists=True, file_okay=False), and init prints each scaffold warning to stderr.
ScaffoldResult gains warnings, set when a new manifesto sits beside a kept index or log that does not name it; kept files are still never edited.
Tests for a missing path, a file path, the partial-bundle warnings on stderr, and the warnings field in --json.
